## Trainer key | Analyst clinic

### Setup and release order

Give H9 pages 1–5 first. Hold evidence cards E1–E8 until a relevant question is asked. Answer from the supplied source, name its limit, then show the ID. If a check is absent, say so; do not invent a clean audit. With eight groups, use roughly three minutes each for a question, answer and follow-up, then six minutes for the largest unresolved gap. Learners log two substantial exchanges on page 4. Give the four-page evidence pack after the clinic.

### What the draft note gets wrong

**N1:** The pilot point estimate is about 1,014 AED, but its interval of 862–1,167 AED spans the separate 1,000 AED minimum rule.<br>
**N2:** The three city methods use the same 10,000-business file and different comparisons. Their positive direction is useful, but they are not independent replications of a national effect.<br>
**N3:** The 2.44 benefit–cost ratio revisits the RCT-linked partial model from Session 1. It assumes 1,800 AED delivery cost, equal annual savings in years 1–5 and a 5% rate. These are not measured national returns or complete costs.

### Judge answers against questions

E3 answers the pilot interval question but not national reach. E4 honestly says earlier trends are unavailable. E5 gives a concrete pre-programme comparability concern near the cut-off. E6 gives reuse and residual gaps, not a full support or selection check. E7 cannot establish real-world fieldwork quality from a complete synthetic file. E8 identifies assumptions, not verified long-run savings.

Accept a bounded next phase with specified evaluation and cost monitoring, or a request for further evidence, when the participant cites a source, states its boundary and names an accountable next step. A decision may remain unchanged while its justification improves. Collect the independent recommendation before offering the optional Copilot extension.

### Optional 15-minute extension

The supplied AI answer contains useful early observations. Its later assurances about independent studies, national savings and data reliability are unsupported. Stage 1 (8 minutes) is source-based markup; Stage 2 (7 minutes) uses the improved prompt or prepared paper alternative. Do not treat either response as new evidence.
